system.description: • Effect: Your Bent Path shot now treats Full Cover as Half Cover (you can target it, with Disadvantage) and ignores a shield's AC bonus, including magical bonuses. Requires Running Shot's movement trigger to have been met this turn.

rules.value: Bent Path (Improved): if Running Shot's movement trigger was met this turn, your Bent Path shot treats Full Cover as Half Cover (you can target it with Disadvantage) and ignores a shield's AC bonus, including magical bonuses.
